newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Tuesday as technical buying supported the market in the afternoon session, traders said.
Prices were 60 to 180 yen higher, with the benchmark July 1998 contract up 100 yen at 13,890 yen per tonne.

A weaker Chicago market overnight triggered light selling in Tokyo from the opening, traders said. But technical buying supported the market by late afternoon, as local investors assumed the benchmark July 1998 contract was unlikely to fall sharply below the 14,000 yen level.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.60-1/2 per bushel at 0655 GMT, unchanged from Monday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean futures were trading at $8.32-1/2 a bushel at 0655 GMT, down from $8.36 at Monday's close.
